findings.summary: The pin named a system that could not be checked, and three tiles carried classes present in neither the pinned stylesheet nor the live site.
findings.detail: The footnotes tile came from a WET-BOEW demo page and used its scaffolding classes (wb-fnotes, footnotes, example-body), which match neither current WET nor canada.ca; the current component is aside.wb-fnote with fn-lnk/fn-rtn, all verified canon. WET-BOEW ships no npm package, so groundTruth is live-site: a snapshot mechanism, not a CI-installable one, and the stylesheet is vendored so the check is still reproducible.

findings.summary: Two classes are real on the site but not part of WET-BOEW.
findings.detail: card/doormat is consequently left unstamped: its faithful markup depends on a class the toolkit does not define. The alternative (wb-eqht-grd) is noted in the tile, but the tile keeps what the live site actually uses, because a registry that mirrors canada.ca should mirror canada.ca.
